svg.title: Identify and heartbeat LEDs: architecture
svg.text: Identify and heartbeat LEDs: every layer and how they plug together
Our BeagleBone with the LED stand-in (C++ or Rust version). Labels on arrows (orange) are the exact "plugs": D-Bus names, paths, properties, files.

Remove: section 11 of the C++ guide.

Optional: let the kernel heartbeat own USR0.
